ideas.pitch: A meta-prompting engine that chains LLM outputs through logic gates to automatically generate working single-page web applications from natural language specifications.
ideas.title: PromptCircuit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the hackathon's core premise of building working software entirely through advanced prompting techniques rather than writing standard code.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered constraint solver that translates natural language game rules directly into playable browser logic without traditional coding.
ideas.title: LogicWeave
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the hackathon theme combining AI, creativity, and explicit logic constraints to build tangible working experiences.

ideas.pitch: A prompt-orchestrated multimedia synthesis pipeline that transforms abstract narrative prompts into interactive visual storyboards with generated assets.
ideas.title: CreativityEngine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the creative and imaginative track of the challenge by turning passive prompts into structured, multi-modal software assets.

ideas.pitch: A structured prompt compiler that turns vague user intents into validated JSON schemas and executing micro-services on the fly.
ideas.title: PromptSchema
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by transforming unstructured natural language into strictly typed, executable software architectures.

ideas.pitch: A prompt-to-agent platform that auto-generates specialized multi-agent workflows using system prompt compositions.
ideas.title: MetaAgent Builder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the trend of autonomous agent orchestration while strictly emphasizing prompt-driven software construction.
